newsitem.title: MEXICO: Tropical storm Carlos strengthens off Mexican.
newsitem.headline: Tropical storm Carlos strengthens off Mexican.

text.p: Tropical Storm Carlos, the third weather system of the hurricane season, strengthened slightly on Wednesday off Mexico's Pacific Coast, the National Weather Service said.

Carlos was expected to continue moving west northwesterly and at 1300 local (18 GMT) should be located 138 miles (220 km) west of Isla Socorro in Colima state, packing winds of 47 mph (75 km/h) and gusts of 60 mph (95 km/h), it added

Shipping warnings have been posted in the Pacific around the islands of Revillagigedo and Socorro, and Carlos is causing heavy rains in Colima state, the service said. Waves of up to 12 feet (four metres) are also reported.
